description: This file implements an iMessage RPC client class that manages communication with an external process via JSON-RPC over a child process, including starting/stopping the process, handling responses and notifications, and managing request timeouts.

classes.name: IMessageRpcClient
classes.description: A class that manages an RPC client communicating with an external process via JSON-RPC, handling process lifecycle, message sending, response handling, and notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RPC client by spawning the external process and setting up communication channels.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the RPC client by closing communication channels and terminating the process.

methods.name: waitForClose
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the RPC client has closed.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request to the external process and waits for the response, with optional timeout.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Handles a line of output from the external process, parsing JSON and dispatching responses or notifications.

methods.name: failAll
methods.description: Fails all pending requests with the provided error.
